roadmapTask: Horizon 11 of the agent-agnostic-browser-bridge project (tools/chrome-bridge/). Add a single new generic page action `waitFor` that blocks until a page condition holds before returning: a CSS selector appears in the sandbox tab's DOM, the page's captured network activity goes idle, or a fixed delay elapses — each bounded by a timeout. It targets the dedicated sandbox tab like every other page action, must be CSP-safe (no string eval), and must add no new manifest permission. Resolves package blocker #3. Follow the established add-one-atomic-page-action-across-the-parity-surface then live-Chrome head-to-head verification pattern used by horizons 7-10.
